description: This Java source file defines an ExceptionMapper for mapping InvalidJsonException into an HTTP response with standardized error message format. It registers as a provider to handle invalid JSON request bodies in the application.

classes.name: InvalidJsonExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS ExceptionMapper that converts InvalidJsonException into a HTTP 400 Bad Request response with a JSON error payload.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an InvalidJsonException into a JSON response indicating an invalid request body.
